comment: This class is a lot of work. Her exams are really hard and she does not give any sort of practice. Day to day it is pretty easy. The models are time consuming but doable and she will do it for you if you go to office hours and need help. Homework is light. The exams are what kills you so have to do well in everything else. She is so kind and nice.

Cassandra is the best. Content is difficult but she is willing to help when necessary and the exams are exactly what is taught during lectures. Pay attention and study hw and you'll be fine. She is also very lenient if you need to miss a class.

Great professor, conveys the material very well. This class is pretty tricky if you haven't taken a few accounting classes already, so you need to put in the work to understand what's going on. Very accessible to go over concepts you don't understand. I'd recommend finding someone to do homework with.

Marshall made what should be a miserable class a tiny bit less miserable. She genuinely cares and explains things well, but class can be VERY boring and tedious. If she could do a better job at engaging the students, this would be a much more enjoyable class. Do the homework and review it before tests and you'll do well.

Professor Marshall is the ideal choice for Finance 360. She is extremely knowledgeable about finance, and most days I would approach her about questions about my personal investing habits and she was always happy to shed light on any topic from class. She is a phenomenal teacher. The final exam is mildly difficult unless you put the work in.

Professor Marshall is very nice but my greatest complaint about this class was how the material was organized and taught to us. Her slides are not very cohesive and it took great work on my end to understand what she wanted us to learn. Reading the textbook for this class is very necessary because she only teaches from that.
Great teacher who is dedicated to her students.

She gives very clear lectures. She is very open to suggestions. On the first segment, she had very little extra practice questions, but after putting out a questionnaire she now has tons of extra material. She is very available outside of class. Homework is never over-the-top difficult.

i still cant tell if i liked her or not. she was okay and shes very considerate. but sometimes in the middle of explaining things she gets a little quiet and mumbly. i don't think shes great at teaching and id only take her class if i cant get any other professor. u have to read the long exhaustive textbook to do well in class for the mcqs on exams
Organized, respectful, thorough. Lots of Excel projects, which give real-world experience.

Professor Marshall is a great instructor. She works through a lot of problems in the course and emphasizes material from the course pack. From the jump, she will tell you the steps to success and doing homework and quizzes should prepare you well for the exams. She is available to answer questions and gives you options to boost your grades.

No real world experience.  Speaks way too quietly.  Speaks directly into the board while talking and constantly references her notes because she clearly doesn't know how to do her own examples.  Midterm exam is worth 35% of your final grade...which will destroy your chances of passing if you don't do well. Horribly boring class and not easy.

She is way too quiet to be a professor, knows nothing about finance in the real world- only academically. Her exam was way too hard for the class. She turns her back to the class and covers the board notes. You'll have to do the "learning" on your own. If you are a FIN major don't take her.
Dr. Marshall is awesome. Her tests are easy and her class is well structured and organized. An A is practically assured in her class. Textbook=useless since her class notes are enough.
